pr_title: Make noise if trying to use the cache after it's been disposed.
pr_body:
SRC.MemoryCache silently fails to add after Dispose().

With this PR, you can set an option when creating a cache
that will tell the cache to be more vocal when trying to use
a cache that has been disposed.

Fixes #1424
pr_comments: @HongGit and @mconnew, I took a quick look at this caching bug in our untriaged bucket tonight and realized I actually worked on a fix for this several months ago before the issue got lost in the shuffle. Figured since the work was already done, we might try to squeeze one more PR in before the 6.0 window closes, so I triaged it into 6.0 for this PR.

issue_context.title: MemoryCache erroneously reports successful additions after it's been disposed
